evidenceNature: Real GitHub CI and independent-audit outcomes from the final PR #48 remediation sequence, replayed through the current production remediation state machine. The historical sequence was not originally driven by this replay test, so the evidence does not claim retroactive controller ownership. Per-step implementationAttempt/auditRemediationAttempt labels reflect the corrected budget separation from issues #130/#134/#139: only material attempts that follow classified/ci-failed-remediable consume maxImplementationAttempts, while a remediation started from audit-failed-remediable consumes only maxAuditRemediationAttempts. Immutable GitHub facts (SHAs, workflow run IDs, decisions, findings) are unchanged.

blockingFindings.violatedContract: MASTER_SPEC.md §4.2 Fail closed and §12 DV2-008 GitHub-native independent audit
blockingFindings.failureMode: The pilot regression did not prove mandatory workflow provenance and exact PR/base/head/repository bindings field by field.
blockingFindings.evidence: CANDIDATE.diff lines 55-57 assign the same BLOB and WORKFLOW_SOURCE to candidate and trustedBase; line 72 asserts only workflowId; lines 74-75 exercise only deletion of the whole object. This does not cover the exact identity and trusted workflow-evidence acceptance conditions stated for the candidate and required by DV2-008's fail-closed evidence contract.

ci.cause: The new remediation test expected an exception at the wrong validation boundary; Node test runner reported Missing expected exception.

boundedAlternative.hypothesis: The real sequence used only 2 of 3 material implementationAttempts and 1 of 2 auditRemediationAttempts, because the audit-triggered remediation at sequence 2 correctly consumed only the auditRemediation budget (issues #130/#134/#139). If the third material attempt had produced another actionable CI failure, one more material implementation attempt would still be authorized; only a subsequent (fourth) material actionable failure exhausts maxImplementationAttempts and must escalate.

conclusion: The final real PR #48 sequence contains one independent-audit rejection, one actionable CI failure during remediation, and a subsequent exact-SHA CI plus independent-audit approval. Replaying those real outcomes through the current DV2 remediation state machine reaches the approved merge path using only 2 of 3 material implementation attempts and 1 of 2 audit-remediation attempts; the same live state deterministically escalates only once a fourth material implementation attempt would otherwise be required.
